sentences.japanese: でも可能性は低そうだね。
教師の給料は弁護士よりも低い。
sentences.english: The salary of a teacher is lower than that of a lawyer.

sentences.japanese: 給料が低いので彼は暮らし向きがよくならない。
sentences.english: He is not better off because he is poorly paid.

sentences.japanese: 丘には低い木がたくさん茂っている。
sentences.english: Lots of low trees grow on the hill.

sentences.japanese: 気温が低いと水は氷になる。
sentences.english: Low temperatures turn water into ice.
